description: Docker container metrics for Coolify hosts. Top row: host CPU/memory headroom (value) plus capacity pies (projects vs Available free capacity on the box). Detail panels group by project → resourceName → service → container.name. Requires collector container_labels_to_metric_labels mapping.
title: Coolify Container Metrics

9d84cf1a-19be-4ac1-b267-750756484e75.name: host.name

a2000002-0002-4000-8000-000000000004.name: coolify.projectName
a2000002-0002-4000-8000-000000000004.queryValue:
SELECT DISTINCT JSONExtractString(labels, 'coolify.projectName')
FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4_1day
WHERE metric_name LIKE 'container_%' AND unix_milli >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'coolify.projectName') != '';

a2000002-0002-4000-8000-000000000001.description: Stable Coolify app slug (coolify.resourceName; survives rolling updates)

widgets.description: Host memory used / total (excluding cache/buffers in numerator via state=used). Shows how close the host is to full RAM.

widgets.description: Full host CPU capacity. Slices = Coolify projects (container CPU, 1.0 ≈ 1 core); Available = idle cores; Other = non-container system CPU. The Available gap is free headroom.

filter.expression: host.name IN $host.name
(host.name IN $host.name AND state = 'idle')
host.name IN $host.name
host.name IN $host.name

widgets.title: Memory capacity (projects + available)
widgets.description: Full host RAM. Slices = Coolify projects (container working set); Available = free host memory; Other = non-container host usage (kernel, caches counted as used, etc.). On a 2 GiB box the whole pie is ~2 GiB — Available is the unused gap.

filter.expression: host.name IN $host.name
(host.name IN $host.name AND state = 'free')
(host.name IN $host.name AND state = 'used')
host.name IN $host.name
